conclusion.prefill: The optional WKV route improved median prefill throughput by 1.214072x for this exact MTT S70, 0.1B, batch-1, prompt-128 configuration.
conclusion.decode: Median decode throughput was 1.000000x; this evidence does not support a decode-acceleration claim.
conclusion.memory: Peak allocated MUSA memory was 406.0 MiB in both modes; this evidence does not support a memory-reduction claim.
conclusion.scope: Exact-device narrow evidence only; do not generalize to other MUSA cards, models, batches, sequence lengths, bf16, quantization, graph capture, multi-device, or training kernels.
